links.to_node: I implement the energy-efficient lighting system throughout the city.
The city's overall energy consumption decreases
The night sky becomes clearer due to reduced light pollution
City residents experience reduced energy bills
Nocturnal wildlife behaviors are disrupted due to changes in lighting
Disruption to nocturnal wildlife is less severe than it would be with high-intensity security lights
